# Workspace guidance

- This is a React 19 and Vite storefront using plain JavaScript and CSS.
- Keep the Circuit Supply catalog-first layout, Space Grotesk/DM Sans typography, cobalt and lime accents, and responsive behavior consistent when changing the UI.
- Cart, saved items, and comparison are client-side demo state; do not imply checkout processes a real payment.
- Run `npm run build` to validate app changes.
